notes: Starter catalogue, not an exhaustive universe of SKUs.
Validate local terms and legal categories with sellers, buyers and country regulators.
Attributes are reusable profiles; production implementation must assign individual attributes and requiredness to each leaf type.
Never activate regulated listings solely because a taxonomy node exists.

node_defaults.note: A subcategory default is inherited by its leaf types unless a type-level override is added. Final production requiredness must be configured per leaf type.
